sql: SELECT agv_id, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aborted_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_tasks, ROUND(AVG(delay_s), 1) AS avg_delay_s FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC, agv_id ASC, shift_code ASC LIMIT 20
